package types

import errorsmod "cosmossdk.io/errors"

const ModuleName = "probe"

func identity(e *errorsmod.Error) *errorsmod.Error { return e }

var ErrOne = errorsmod.Register(ModuleName, 2, "one")

// Registers for real, but the immediate callee is identity. The first parser
// skipped this silently.
var ErrNested = identity(
	errorsmod.Register(ModuleName, 3, "nested"),
)
